snippet.title: Sooooooooooo: Strike, Scream, Run! - Steam
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5015740/Sooooooooooo_Strike_Scream_Run/

Let out your best Sooooooooooo!

In Sooooooooooo! Strike, Scream, Run!, your microphone is your weapon. Attack by screaming and turn everything into absolute chaos filled with screams and laughter.

Two species. One goal

Orcas: Hunt down the Dolphins, scream to enter attack mode, and kick them out of the match.

Dolphins: Dodge, hide, and fight back when the Orca runs out of breath.

Three ways to ruin a friendship

Kick Them All: Kick every Dolphin to win.

The Last Orca Loses: There can only be one Orca. Switch sides by kicking other players. The last Orca standing loses!

Evangelizing Kick: Every Dolphin you kick joins your team. Convert them all!

Scream with your friends. Cause chaos

Use ridiculous power-ups, send your friends flying, and survive earthquakes and explosions of your rivals’ poop. Create public or private lobbies, customize your matches, and use the built-in voice chat. Online multiplayer for up to 8 players (performance depends on the host’s connection). 

A microphone is required to play.

-

Trailer Music Credits

"Russian Dance (Trepak)" - The Nutcracker - Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky.

Conducted by Philip Milman. Funded by Ludwig Ahgren and Jschlatt.

Licensed under CC BY 3.0.

Original recording - Wikimedia Commons

Recording edited and combined with additional vocals and sound effects for the trailer.
